objective: Avoid iterator collection overhead when resolving single-table DELETE permissions.

tasks.title: Build DELETE permission entries directly
tasks.result: DELETE permission resolution now directly constructs the zero-or-one entry result instead of routing through Option iterator collection.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The change preserves the existing first-table DELETE permission behavior.
A DELETE statement_permissions assertion was added beside existing permission-resolution cases.
